versions.changelog:
Initial release of PubMed Search skill.

- Search 30M+ PubMed articles, including both open-access and non-open-access.
- Retrieve abstracts for all articles; auto-fetch full text for PMC open-access articles.
- Supports full PubMed query syntax, batch processing, and per-journal searches.
- No API key required; public NCBI E-utilities with built-in rate limiting.
- Includes detailed command-line and programmatic API usage examples.
